nodes.name: Institutional Equity Trader
nodes.description: Executes equity block and algorithmic orders through TraderX Workstation.

nodes.name: TraderX Blotter Web UI
nodes.description: Browser order blotter for institutional equity trading desks.

nodes.name: Legacy Order Monolith
nodes.description: Java EE monolithic order capture, booking, and position engine.

nodes.name: Legacy Oracle Trades DB
nodes.description: Single-region relational store holding orders, fills, and EOD blotters.

nodes.name: Zero-Trust Edge API Gateway
nodes.description: Envoy-based ingress gateway terminating TLS 1.3 and enforcing OIDC bearer tokens.

nodes.name: Enterprise OIDC Identity Provider
nodes.description: Issues short-lived FAPI-compliant OAuth 2.1 / OIDC tokens for trading desks.

nodes.name: Kafka Order Event Backbone
nodes.description: Partitioned low-latency event log carrying order commands, risk approvals, and execution fills.

nodes.name: Stateless Order Router
nodes.description: Validates FIX/REST order payloads, assigns clOrdId, and orchestrates routing.

relationships.description: Trader submits and monitors orders via web blotter.
Monolith persists orders and fills in Oracle.
Web blotter sends authenticated order requests over HTTPS.
Web blotter performs OAuth 2.1 PKCE login handshake.
Gateway validates JWT signatures via OIDC JWKS endpoint.
Gateway dispatches validated client orders to stateless router over mTLS.
Order router publishes normalized OrderSubmitted events.
Legacy monolith consumes order events during strangler migration.

mtls-everywhere.description: Requires SPIFFE/SPIRE mTLS certificates across internal service-to-service trading hops.

config.name: East-West Mutual TLS Enforcement
config.description: Requires SPIFFE/SPIRE mTLS certificates across internal service-to-service trading hops.

flows.name: Client Order Submission Flow
flows.description: End-to-end ingress path from trader workstation blotter into the Kafka order event log.

transitions.description: Trader stages equity order ticket in blotter.
Gateway forwards order over gRPC/mTLS to order router.
Router appends normalized event to Kafka.
